updates.content:
Title: Users see Microsoft Teams on the web displayed in English

User impact: Users see Microsoft Teams on the web displayed in English.

More info: Affected users don’t have English set as their preferred language.

Current status: We’re reviewing system logs to isolate the origin of this issue.

Scope of impact: Your organization is affected by this event, and some users see Microsoft Teams on the web displayed in English when it isn’t their preferred language. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

Next update by: Tuesday, October 6, 2026, at 6:30 AM UTC

Title: Users see Microsoft Teams on the web displayed in English

User impact: Users see Microsoft Teams on the web displayed in English.

More info: Affected users don’t have English set as their preferred language.

Current status: We’ve determined that a redirection issue is incorrectly applying English language settings when users access Microsoft Teams on the web. We’re reviewing options to correct this behavior and working with affected users to collect additional logs to better understand the impact scenario and fully resolve the issue.

Scope of impact: Your organization is affected by this event, and some users see Microsoft Teams on the web displayed in English when it isn’t their preferred language. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

Next update by: Wednesday, October 7, 2026, at 4:00 AM UTC
